mapper.insert: insert into aqi_feedback (tel_id, province_id, city_id, address, information, estimated_grade, af_date, af_time, state, remarks) values (#{telId}, #{provinceId}, #{cityId}, #{address}, #{information}, #{estimatedGrade}, #{afDate}, #{afTime}, #{state}, #{remarks})
mapper.select: select af.af_id as afId, af.tel_id as telId, af.province_id as provinceId, af.city_id as cityId, af.address as address, af.information as information, af.estimated_grade as estimatedGrade, af.af_date as afDate, af.af_time as afTime, af.gm_id as gmId, af.assign_date as assignDate, af.assign_time as assignTime, af.state as state, af.remarks as remarks, p.province_name as provinceName, c.city_name as cityName, a.aqi_explain as aqiExplain, a.chinese_explain as chineseExplain, a.color as color, s.real_name as realName from aqi_feedback af left join grid_province p on af.province_id = p.province_id left join grid_city c on af.city_id = c.city_id left join aqi a on af.estimated_grade = a.aqi_id left join supervisor s on af.tel_id = s.tel_id where af.tel_id = #{telId} order by af.af_id desc

select af.af_id as afId, af.tel_id as telId, af.province_id as provinceId, af.city_id as cityId, af.address as address, af.information as information, af.estimated_grade as estimatedGrade, af.af_date as afDate, af.af_time as afTime, af.gm_id as gmId, af.assign_date as assignDate, af.assign_time as assignTime, af.state as state, af.remarks as remarks, p.province_name as provinceName, c.city_name as cityName, a.aqi_explain as aqiExplain, a.chinese_explain as chineseExplain, a.color as color, s.real_name as realName from aqi_feedback af left join grid_province p on af.province_id = p.province_id left join grid_city c on af.city_id = c.city_id left join aqi a on af.estimated_grade = a.aqi_id left join supervisor s on af.tel_id = s.tel_id where af.gm_id = #{gmId} order by af.af_id desc
mapper.update: update aqi_feedback set state = #{state} where af_id = #{afId}
